title: Battle Army Tools
description: Battle Army Tools 0.5.13. Fixes Commander turn tracking for battles with multiple commanders inside two or more teams. Commander mode now gives each commander a separate turn, groups the suggested order by Team, shows Team + Commander in the Battle Turn HUD, and correctly matches command-token rows/resets. Retains v0.5.12 controller-Actor ownership, board-edge deployment, combat, tactical Drawing isolation, and undo systems.
